scenarios.scenario: In this training tenant, a policy requires MFA for the pilot group. A pilot user signs in without an MFA prompt. The sign-in log shows the policy was not applied.
scenarios.evidence: The user is a pilot-group member and is also in a group explicitly excluded from the policy.
options: Review the exclusion membership and test the policy with the affected pilot user
Disable MFA globally and ask every user to change their password
Delete the pilot user and recreate the account before inspecting policy scope
Reinstall Office on every pilot device without checking policy exclusions
scenarios.correctAnswer: Review the exclusion membership and test the policy with the affected pilot user
scenarios.explanation: The log indicates that the policy was not applied, and the supplied membership evidence identifies an exclusion. Review that targeted exclusion and test the affected user before changing unrelated controls.
hints: Separate a policy that was not applied from an authentication challenge that failed.

scenarios.scenario: An exercise requires a new access rule to protect a pilot group while keeping a documented recovery account available. Choose a rollout that satisfies every stated constraint.
scenarios.evidence: Pilot sign-ins can be inspected before enforcement; the recovery account has separate monitoring.
constraints: Validate the pilot impact before broad enforcement
options: Validate the scoped pilot rule, retain the documented recovery exception, and monitor both paths before expanding
Enforce the rule for every account immediately and remove the recovery exception
Exclude all pilot users permanently and stop monitoring their sign-ins
Disable the access rule globally and rely only on password changes
scenarios.correctAnswer: Validate the scoped pilot rule, retain the documented recovery exception, and monitor both paths before expanding
scenarios.explanation: The scoped pilot rollout satisfies all three exercise constraints: staged validation, a retained recovery path, and monitoring. The other plans respectively risk lockout, abandon pilot protection, or remove the required access control.
hints: Check each option against all three constraints; satisfying only one is insufficient.
